units.source_text: 阿雪还收集客人抽剩的烟蒂，把烟嘴掐掉，积攒起来。

en.t: Oyuki also collected the cigarette butts left by guests, pinched off the mouthpieces, and saved them up.

units.source_text: 到了一定数量，再把它剥开，用报纸将烟叶包好，寄给港町的爷爷。

en.t: When she had gathered a certain amount, she would split them open, wrap the tobacco leaves in newspaper, and send them to her grandfather in the port town.
